ignoreValues.reason: Body face only; display is Bricolage Grotesque, mono is IBM Plex Mono

ignoreRuleReasons.side-tab: Two devices, both deliberate. The 4px left rule on the verdict, caveats and empty-state blocks is this site's pull-quote marker; the 4px top rule on the four answer cards is the line-colour key, which is how the reader knows which card belongs to prices, pay or housing. Both are used consistently and paired with a newspaper palette rather than a SaaS card stack. The rule also fires on two 3px left rules that serve the same pull-quote role.
ignoreRuleReasons.flat-type-hierarchy: The detector cannot resolve clamp(); the display sizes it misses run to 60px on the h1 and 32px on the answer cards, so the real ratio is about 5:1, not 1.7:1.
ignoreRuleReasons.repeating-stripes-gradient: The only repeating gradient is the dashed stem on the mortgage marker, where the dash encodes a derived series rather than a measured one. It is data, not decoration.
